brief: A narrow, moody Parisian-style café with dark wood-panelled walls and a long matte-black raised-panel service counter with a veined black stone top along the right. The counter carries a glass pastry case, twin grinders, an espresso machine and many vases of flowers and tea lights. The left side is a tall street window with a wooden window ledge and round-seat wooden stools, and an olive tree in a pot stands beside it. Round bistro tables with bentwood chairs run down the middle on dark plank flooring, with worn Persian runners in the aisle. A large crystal chandelier hangs over the counter, with small pendants and wall sconces. Backbar shelves of dark wood hold coffee bags, jars, bottles and stacked cups under a big framed blackboard menu. The mood is warm, candlelit and intimate.
